tickets.title: Laptop will not boot after update
tickets.description: After last night's update the laptop shows the manufacturer logo and then a black screen. It does not reach the login window. Holding the power button turns it off. This is the machine I use for class.

tickets.title: Classroom projector has no input
tickets.description: The projector in SC 204 stays on the splash screen. HDMI from the podium laptop does not switch the source. Class starts in an hour.

tickets.title: Cannot connect to campus Wi-Fi
tickets.description: I can see Campus-Secure in the Wi-Fi list, but my laptop never finishes connecting. I tried forgetting the network and signing in again with my student account. This started this morning in the library. Wired ethernet in the lab still works.

tickets.title: Need Adobe license for ART 131
tickets.description: ART 131 starts next week and the lab computers say the Adobe license has expired. Photoshop and Illustrator both fail to open. I need a license before the first studio day.

tickets.title: Library printer jammed
tickets.description: The printer by the library entrance shows a paper jam and will not print. The display says to clear the rear tray. I do not see paper there. Other students are lined up.

tickets.title: Password reset for lab account
tickets.description: I can sign in to email, but the CS lab account rejects my password. I have not changed it. I need access before tonight's lab.

notes.author: IT staff
notes.body: Picked up the laptop. Trying a boot repair before replacing the drive.

notes.body: Cleared a torn sheet from the rear tray.

notes.author: IT staff
